card.name: The future of... in tech writing
card.fires_on: The word "future" and the "of" right after it, in titles and phrases like "The Future of Things" or "the future of solar". Also forward-looking phrases such as "a new frontier of jobs".

modes.label: "of" after future
modes.description: The word "of" directly following "future" in a phrase about what is coming.
modes.example: A safety demonstration of the latest automobile technology let reporters take a peek at what could possibly be the future<< of>> our nation’s highways.

modes.label: The word future itself
modes.description: "Future" in a title or phrase, just before "of".
modes.example: Anuradha Menon and Sarah Gingichashvili write for the electronic magazine The<< Future>> of Things at www.thefutureof

modes.label: Other forward-looking phrases
modes.description: Words in phrases about new frontiers or changing the world, in a technology or progress setting.
modes.example: help train kids for a<< new>> frontier of jobs
